title: 'Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita.' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Metabo Hagure 's Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madousho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tatakitsubushimasu ( A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ) light novel unveiled additional cast, staff, and the first promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 6 at 10:30 p.m. on TV Tokyo, BS11, AT-X, and other channels in July 2026.

Voice actresses Yuu Serizawa ( Isekai Maou to Shoukan Shoujo no Dorei Majutsu ) and Shizuka Ishigami ( Vinland Saga ) are joining the cast as Tidus and Elsa Archfield, respectively.

Staff Sub-Character Design: Taiga Fuchiwaki ( Tsuki to Laika to Nosferatu )) Prop Design: Nishimoto Seiji ( Fragtime ), Taiga Fuchiwaki ( Izure Saikyou no Renkinjutsushi? ) Art Director, Art Design: Miho Kawakami (Jack) ( Kisaki Kyouiku kara Nigetai Watashi ) Color Design: Ryouya Koga (Studio L) ( Okashi na Tensei ) Director of Photography: Shintarou Sakai (Studio Twinkle) ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) Offline Editing: Kentarou Yamada (Okayasu Promotion) ( Shirobuta Kizoku desu ga Zense no Kioku ga Haeta node Hiyoko na Otouto Sodatemasu ) Sound Director: Jun Watanabe ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) Sound Effects: Yuika Shiraishi ( 5-toubun no Hanayome ) Sound Production: Jinnan Studio

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Izure Saikyou no Renkinjutsushi? ) is directing the anime at Studio Comet . Mitsutaka Hirota ( Gimai Seikatsu ) is handling the series composition and Sayaka Anezaki ( Touhai: Ura Rate Mahjong Touhairoku ) is designing the characters. Satoshi Houno ( Isekai Yakkyoku ) and Kaori Nakano ( Fuguushoku "Kanteishi" ga Jitsu wa Saikyou Datta ) are composing the music.

Hagure began penning the fantasy drama novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2020. Hobby Japan began publishing the novel in May 2022, featuring illustrations by Masami ( Kanpekisugite Kawaige ga Nai to Konyaku Haki sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru ). The seventh volume went on sale in August 2025.

Oonoimo began drawing a manga adaptation in Comic Fire in May 2022. Hobby Japan published the tenth volume on March 2.

J-Novel Club licensed the manga and light novel for digital release in English in November 2023 and January 2024, respectively. The seventh light novel volume was released on May 13. The seventh manga volume was published on March 25, with the eighth volume will go on sale on July 1.

PV 1

title: Illustrator neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls Project Gets TV Anime
content:
Good Smile Company announced on Friday that illustrator neco 's Heavily Armed High School Girls ( Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei ) project is getting a television anime adaptation that will air in 2027.

Masaki Tachibana ( Princess Principal , Barakamon , Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 ) is directing the anime, and Natsuko Takahashi ( Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 , My Love Story!! , Love and Lies ) is overseeing the series scripts. Good Smile Film and Good Smile Company are jointly producing the anime.

neco 's project includes illustrations and figures. The above video and visual feature the character Ichi.

neco is also known for the original character designs for such franchises as Synduality: Noir and Why Does Nobody Remember Me in This World? . neco 's Ore no Yubi de Midarero. Heiten-go no Salon, Ijiwaru ni Jirasarete manga inspired the Crazy Over His Fingers TV anime.

title: 'Hell Mode 2nd Season' Unveiled Supporting Cast Pair, Opening Theme, Main Promo
content:
• The official website of the Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru 2nd Season ( Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2 ) television anime unveiled an additional pair of cast, opening theme, and the main promotional video on Friday.

The second season adapting Hamuo 's action fantasy light novel will begin airing on Tokyo MX at 1:00 a.m. on July 4, followed by broadcasts on MBS, AT-X, and BS Nippon Television.

Voice actors Taketora ( Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou ) and Shinichiro Miki ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu ) are joining the cast as Dverg and Theodosir, respectively.

Musical band Romanha Marshmallow is performing the opening theme "○✕△□," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Masato Tamagawa ( Tensai Ouji no Akaji Kokka Saisei Jutsu ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab , with Daishirou Tanimura ( Mahou Shoujo Magical Destroyers ) handling the series composition. Kei Tsushima ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These ) is designing the characters.

Misaki Tsuchida ( The New Gate ), Moyu Kanazaki , Junko Nakajima ( Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu. ), Kanade Sakuma ( Akuyaku Reijou nanode Last Boss wo Kattemimashita ), Reiko Abe ( Akuyaku Reijou Tensei Ojisan ), Kaho Sawada ( Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai ), Beau Damian ( Ore wa Subete wo "Parry" suru ), Tsugumi Tanaka ( Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite ), Shuichiro Fukuhiro ( The Fable ), and Shin Miki are composing the music.

Produced by Yokohama Animation Lab , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Winter 2026. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, with HIDIVE simulcasting the series with multiple subtitles.

Hamuo began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2019. Earth Star Entertainment acquired the novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in July 2020, featuring illustrations by Mo . The 13th volume went on sale on January 15, and the 14th volume is scheduled for release on July 15.

Enji Tetta began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth☆Star web magazine in October 2020. The 13th volume was released on January 9.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga for digital release in English in July 2021 and July 2023, respectively. The 11th light novel volume went on sale in December 2025, and the 12th volume is scheduled for release on August 5. The tenth manga volume was released on April 29.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast members on Friday. The anime adapting CLAMP 's mahou shoujo manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame at 11.45 p.m. in October 2026.

Cast Emeraude: Saori Hayami ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Zagato: Yuuki Ono ( Beastars ) Mokona: Mika Kikuchi ( Tsubasa Chronicle )

Yui Umemoto ( Ninja Kamui ) is directing at E&H Production . Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is handling the series composition and Satomi Watanabe ( Aikatsu! ) is desiigning the characters. Yuki Kajiura ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica ), Takumi Ozawa ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ), and Shiho Terada ( Inazuma Eleven Go ) are composing the music.

CLAMP serialized the manga in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel manga began in the same month and ended in March 1996.

Tokyopop licensed both manga in 1997, followed by Dark Horse Comics in 2009, and then Kodansha USA in 2019 with two hard-cover box sets containing three volumes each.

title: BLACK TORCH Anime Reveals New Trailer, Key Visual, Theme Songs by SiM and I Don't Like Mondays
content:
The upcoming BLACK TORCH anime revealed a new key visual and main trailer, while also announcing its opening and ending theme songs ahead of its July 4, 2026 premiere. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018.

The opening theme, “FREEZE ME UP,” will be performed by SiM, while I Don’t Like Mondays. performs the ending theme “Groooovy.” Both songs can be heard for the first time in the newly released trailer.

The second key visual features the main character Jiro Azuma with his mononoke partner Rago. Fellow members of the anti-mononoke special operations unit known as Black Torch also featured. The visual also includes major antagonists Koga and Tenki.

The voice cast was previously introduced in a trailer and includes:

• Ryota Suzuki as Azuma Jiro

• Yoji Ueda as Rago

• Sayaka Senbongi as Ichika Kishimojin

• Junya Enoki as Reiji Kirihara

• Junichi Suwabe as Ryosuke Shiba

• Reina Ueda as Usami

The staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Kei Umabiki

• Character Design: Gou Suzuki

• Series Composition & Screenplay: Gigaemon Ichikawa

• Music: Yutaka Yamada

• Studio: One Double-0 studio

BLACK TORCH originally ran in Jump Square , a monthly magazine published by Shueisha, from February 2017 to April 2018. It later shifted to the Shonen Jump+ digital platform, where it continued until wrapping up in July 2018. The story has a total of 19 chapters, which were compiled into a total of five volumes. The English license was acquired by VIZ Media, with the first volume released on August 7, 2018.

title: Illustrator Neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Illustrator neco’s original multimedia project Heavy Armored High School Girls is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the premiere set for 2027. The adaptation marks the franchise’s first animated project.

Originally launched as a series of illustrations based on the concept of “armed girls × high school students,” Heavy Armored High School Girls has released numerous figure releases and collaborations, with a big following both in Japan and overseas.

The anime will be directed by Masaki Tachibana, known for his work on Princess Principal and episodes of Star Wars: Visions Volume 3 . Series composition is being handled by Natsuko Takahashi ( Yuyushiki , Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 ), while the production is a joint effort between Good Smile Film and Good Smile Company.

According to comments released with the announcement, neco has been actively involved in the adaptation process, working closely with the staff:

“For an illustrator, having your own work become an anime is one of the greatest joys imaginable,” neco said. “Heavy Armored High School Girls started as a single illustration and has grown into figures and now an anime. I hope everyone looks forward to it.”

The anime adaptation was announced with a teaser trailer and a new visual drawn by neco. Both the illustration and teaser trailer feature the series’ main character Ichi.

Director Masayuki Tachibana revealed that he worked closely with neco while developing the anime’s story and characters. According to Tachibana, many of the characters’ personalities were shaped through discussions with the original creator, exploring how each girl might behave beyond their visual designs.

He also noted that hearing the cast’s performances during recording led to new discoveries about the characters, suggesting voice production is already underway despite the series’ 2027 release window.

Series composer Natsuko Takahashi said she was immediately drawn to neco’s designs and the contrast at the heart of the project: girls carrying the burden of powerful weaponry while still living as ordinary high school students. She added that extensive discussions with neco, Tachibana, and the production staff helped shape the adaptation, expressing particular appreciation for the team’s ideas throughout development.

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even TV Anime Reveals 2 More Cast, July 6 Debut in New Trailer
content:
The staff for the television anime of Metabo Hagure 's A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ( Buchigire Reijō wa Hōfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madōsho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu ) light novel series revealed a new trailer and more cast members on Friday. The staff also revealed the show will debut on July 6.

The below videos preview the show's opening theme song.

English-subtitled version (region locked in Japan)

Non-subtitled version (available worldwide)

The new cast includes:

The anime will debut on July 6 and will air on AT-X at 10:30 pm., before later airing on TV Tokyo and BS11 .

The anime stars:

• Saori Ōnishi as Elizabeth Leiston/Ellie Leis

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Mireille Katarina

• Yui Ogura as Lunoa Carlton

• Ayumi Uehara as Misha Tail

• Yōhei Azakami as Lucas Lebrick

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Friede Haldoria

• Marika Kōno as Sylvia Lockit

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Sweet Reincarnation , Saiyuki Gaiden , Wild Adapter ) is directing the anime at Studio Comet , and Mitsutaka Hirota ( Sweet Reincarnation , Rent-A-Girlfriend ) is overseeing the series scripts. Sayaka Anezaki ( Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time , Tohai: Ura Rate Mahjong Tohai Roku ) is designing the characters, and Satoshi Hōno ( Tales of Wedding Rings , Twilight Out of Focus ) and Karin Nakano ( The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom , Clockwork Planet ) are composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Sub Character Design: Yasuka Fuchiwaki

• Prop Setting: Seiji Nishimoto, Yasuka Fuchiwaki

• Art Director / Art Setting: Miho Kawakami (Jack)

• Color Coordinator: Ryōya Koga (Studio L)

• Director of Photography: Shintaro Sakai (Studio Twinkle)

• Offline Editing: Kentarō Yamada (Okayasu Promotions)

• Sound Director: Jun Watanabe

• Sound Effects: Yuika Shiraishi

• Sound Production: Jinnan Studio

Yui Ogura performs the opening theme song "Q.E.D.," and Aguri Ōnishi performs the ending theme song "Goodbye Lullaby."

J-Novel Club licensed the light novel series and manga, and it describes the story:

Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her. The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn't respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it's the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won't hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

The web novel debuted in October 2020 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website, and the last update was in September 2022. The light novel series with illustrations by masami began in May 2022, and the seventh volume shipped on August 19.

Oonoimo launched the manga adaptation on Comic Fire in May 2022. The 10th compiled book volume shipped in Japan on March 2.

title: Victoria of Many Faces TV Anime Reveals July 7 Debut in Short Promo Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series revealed a short promotional video and the anime's July 7 debut on Friday.

The anime will debut on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on July 7 at 24:00 (effectively July 8 at 12:00 a.m.).

The anime stars:

• Chika Anzai as Victoria

• Shion Wakayama as Nonna

• Yōhei Azakami as Jeffrey

• Kenji Nojima as Lancome

• Daisuke Ono as Edward Asher

However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected! On the other hand, the second prince--and others--take an interest in Victoria's strength, and the shadows close in on the woman with many faces…!

title: 'World Is Dancing' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuto Mihara 's World Is Dancing manga revealed additional cast, a character visual (pictured above), and the second promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on July 2 at 10:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX and KBS Kyoto, followed by BS Asahi, Sun TV, and other stations.

Voice actors Youji Matsuda ( Toki wo Kakeru Shoujo ) and Miyuki Sawashiro ( Ikoku Nikki ) are joining the cast as Ineou and Shirabyoushi, respectively.

Toshimasa Kuroyanagi ( Fune wo Amu ) is directing the anime at Cypic , with Sawako Kawamitsu handling the series composition and script. Keigo Sasaki ( Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray ) is designing the characters. Daisuke Shinoda ( Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online II ) is composing the music.

Mihara began serializing the historical manga in Morning magazine in March 2021. Kodansha published the sixth and the final volume in November 2022.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English and published all six volumes digitally from August 2023 to August 2024.

title: New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga revealed three new cast members for the anime on Friday.

The new cast members include (left to right in above image):

• Saori Hayami as Emeraude

• Yūki Ono as Zagato

• Mika Kikuchi as Mokona

Anime Expo will host the anime's world premiere screening on July 4, featuring voice actresses Rie Takahashi and Saori Hayami .

Previously announced cast members include: Ayane Sakura as Hikaru Shidō, Rumi Ōkubo as Umi Ryūzaki, and Rie Takahashi as Fū Hōōji.

Yui Miura (episode director for Ninja Kamui , Bullet/Bullet ) is making his series directorial debut with the anime, and E&H production is producing the anime. Shigeru Murakoshi ( Zombie Land Saga , Ninja Kamui , Apocalypse Hotel ) is in charge of the series scripts. Satomi Watabe ( Escha Chron , Aikatsu Friends! ) is designing the characters. Yuki Kajiura , Takumi Ozawa , and Shiho Terada are composing the music. UNLIMITED PRODUCE by TMS is producing the project.

The anime will air in the "IMAnimation W" programming block on TV Asahi and affiliated channels in October on Wednesdays at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EDT).

Magic Knight Rayearth centers on three high school girls named Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu. On a class field trip to Tokyo Tower, they are magically transported into the fantasy world of Cephiro. They are immediately greeted by the mage Clef, who tells them that the world is dying after the priest Zagato kidnapped Princess Emeraude, whose prayers maintain the state of the world. Without her singing, Cephiro is on the brink of collapse. Imbued with magical powers as the Magic Knights, Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu must learn how to work together to survive and save Cephiro.

The creative circle CLAMP serialzied the Magic Knight Rayearth manga in Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine from 1993 to 1996 with six volumes. The manga inspired two television anime seasons, the first running from October 1994 to March 1995, and the second season, titled Magic Knight Rayearth 2 , running from April to November 1995. The manga also inspired a three-episode 1997 original video anime project simply titled Rayearth , featuring an alternate retelling of the story.

Media Blasters first released the television anime on VHS and DVD in the United States. Discotek Media licensed the anime in 2014, and released it as a complete collection on DVD and Blu-ray Disc in 2017. (The release did not include the Rayearth OVA series.)
